offering_description.value: CarGurus connects car shoppers with dealerships through websites that let shoppers compare listings, prices and dealer reviews. It sells dealers listing subscriptions, advertising and digital tools that help them reach shoppers and start vehicle purchases online. It also operates a UK marketplace for enthusiast cars with classifieds and auctions.

primary_products.value: Dealer listing software; vehicle pricing and market analytics tools; digital retailing software

primary_services.value: Vehicle listings and shopper lead generation; automotive advertising; online vehicle auctions

customer_segment.value: B2B: Franchised and independent car dealerships, dealer groups and automakers; B2C: New and used car shoppers, enthusiast car buyers and private vehicle sellers

end_markets.value: Used vehicle retail; new vehicle retail; enthusiast and collector cars; automotive advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: Dealers pay for listing packages, lead generation and access to digital sales tools; advertising: Automakers and dealerships pay for placements that reach car shoppers; transaction or usage fees: Buyers pay fees on completed enthusiast car auctions
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Aggregates dealer and private-seller inventory for shoppers and provides dealers with pricing and sales tools; service provider: Uses shopper traffic to provide lead generation and advertising to dealers and automakers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada and United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: Vehicle classifieds, dealer sales tools, automotive advertising and enthusiast car auctions

distribution_channels.value: online: Consumer marketplace websites and apps, online auctions and dealer dashboards; direct sales: Sales teams serving dealerships, dealer groups and automakers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Vehicle advertising and shopper data handling are subject to FTC consumer protection rules and applicable privacy laws.

notes: The current status of CarGurus’s dealer-to-dealer wholesale operation is uncertain.
